title: Chapter 1297 - 41: World-Destroying Demonic Power
content:
Chapter 1297 - 41: World-Destroying Demonic Power

Chapter 1297: Chapter 41: World-Destroying Demonic Power

Then, the situation we face next will be much calmer.

Whether it’s Demon Spirited, Great Demon, or even Source Demon, their numbers will be significantly less.

But right after.

The Demon God appeared.

Its face was blurred, its expression indifferent, its eyes vacant, sporting a single horn and dressed in a black robe. The black robe embodied endless darkness, as if all the demonic qi in the world emanated from this robe.

Behind it, a sturdy, pitch-black tail extended across heaven and earth.

Just by watching the recorded images from several major Eternal Sects, Lin Yuan could feel the Demon God’s might.

And precisely because of the Demon God’s appearance, it shattered the intention of several major Eternal Sects to disperse the demonic qi.

It merely took a few steps forward, causing the Eternal Treasures of several major Eternal Sect forces to retreat.

The deep dark demonic qi swept in, from then on, this Source World was completely shrouded in endless demonic qi.

This was the only scene where the Demon God took action.

After that, the Demon God vanished, except for the forces of several major Eternal Sects, with the Eternal Treasures vaguely sensing that the Demon God had not moved far, remaining still in the center of heaven and earth.

No one had ever seen the Demon God continue to take action.

According to the information left by various Eternal Lords, the Demon God’s main focus, or instinct, was used to confront the Source World.

The demonic qi corroded the Source World, requiring suppression of the Source World consciousness, and during its disappearance and slumber, this was mainly its focus.

As for the outside world?

As long as the forces of several major Eternal Sects do not cause too much commotion, the Demon God will not take action.

After all, several major Eternal Sect forces have left behind various arrangements by the Eternal Lords.

Wanting to completely destroy the former, even as the Demon God, would take a considerable amount of time and energy.

With this effort, it would be better to deepen the erosion of the Source World.

"Lord Galaxy, we plan to recall all disciples exploring outside in the near future."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect said softly.

Since Lin Yuan took action, greatly reducing the number of Source Demons in the center of heaven and earth.

The many disciples originally trapped in the sect’s stronghold began to explore the outside world again.

After all, Lin Yuan hunted not only Source Demons, but all demons gathering a bit of demonic qi were his hunting targets.

This led to unusual safety outside, with those terrifying demons rarely seen.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

The signs of the Demon God’s emergence are growing.

At this time, having disciples continue to explore the outside world obviously carries great risk.

Rather, recall them all, hide within the stronghold, even if the Demon God truly descends, there will be the ability to resist.

...

Soon.

One by one, disciples from the Eternal Sect exploring outside received the sect’s recall order.

"The Sect Master wants us to return? Lord Galaxy has cleared away the ’demons’ outside, what’s the point of returning?"

"Indeed, with Lord Galaxy around, those ’demons’ barely have time to escape."

Numerous disciples of the Eternal Sect discussed with each other, for thousands of years, Lin Yuan’s existence held the supreme position among several major Eternal Sects.

Some disciples, especially those who came after the great changes in heaven and earth, revered Lin Yuan even more than their own Eternal Lords.

After the great changes in heaven and earth, the Eternal Lords had never acted, but in the recent thousands of years, Lin Yuan’s actions were seen by all.

That absolute suppression, as strong as Source Demons, seemed as fragile as ants before Lin Yuan’s might, severely impacting countless disciples’ understanding.

"Since the Sect Master wants us back, there must be a reason."

"Yes, we’d better obediently return."

"Just so we can be closer to Lord Galaxy."

The numerous disciples dared not hesitate, they hurried back to the sect’s stronghold.

Even in the outside world filled with demonic qi, careful exploration revealed numerous epochs.

And directly contacting the demonic qi was also beneficial for honing one’s mind.

Thus, the Sect Masters of the major Eternal Sects have silently allowed disciples to explore outside.

...

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, several years went by.

Lin Yuan appeared, flipped his right hand, suppressing two hidden Source Demons deep within time and space, then effortlessly refining them.

"At this rate, to complete the final ten percent of establishing the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World, wouldn’t it take hundreds or even thousands of years?"

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

A tenth of the Constant Sand Particle World is opened up, following Lin Yuan’s efficiency over a previous ten thousand years.

It should only take about a hundred years.

But bear in mind.

The number of Source Demons in the center of the world is showing a decreasing trend.

That is to say, finding the same number of Source Demons will become slower and slower.

Eventually, it could take up to a thousand years to complete the final tenth of the Particle World.

"Take it slow, I’m not in a hurry."

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts, about to search around to see if there were any other hidden ’demons’.

At this moment.

Buzz~

An invisible fluctuation caused all the demonic qi in the Fang Yuan World to ripple instantly.

Like ripples suddenly stirred on a calm water surface, and as time passed, the ripples grew bigger, bigger, and bigger.

"What is this?"

Lin Yuan’s expression turned solemn, and his figure silently vanished from the spot.

Hidden World.

The Sect Masters of the major Eternal Sects were sternly waiting.

In the distance, an eternal treasure, round and square, was shining, a treasure created by several Eternal Lords working together, capable of observing the subtle changes in the whole Source World.

And at this moment, this eternal treasure trembled lightly, as in the center of the world, infinite demonic qi converged, and a figure swiftly emerged.

Its face was blurred, with a detached expression, gaze hollow, having a single horn, dressed in black robes, the black robes containing endless darkness, as if all demonic qi in the world emanated from these black robes.

Behind it, a thick, black tail spanned across the heavens and earth.

Its appearance caused all demonic qi in the world to boil.

The Source Demons lurking deep within the demonic qi immediately appeared, continually worshiping it.

"The Demon God has emerged."

The hearts of several Sect Masters from the Eternal Sects trembled uncontrollably.

Countless millennia ago, it was precisely this existence that shattered the hope of the eternal sects to drive out the demonic qi using their eternal treasure.

Bear in mind, when the world underwent great changes, it was when the eternal sects were at their strongest, yet this Demon God forcibly suppressed them.

If not for Lin Yuan’s sudden emergence a millennium ago, the eternal sects would be distressed even under the pressure of the numerous Source Demons, not to mention facing the Demon God.

"The Demon God?"

Lin Yuan looked at the eternal treasure round and square in the distance.

The treasure projected the Demon God’s figure, causing Lin Yuan’s expression to reveal surprise.

"Such a powerful body," Lin Yuan thought secretly.

Even observing indirectly through the eternal treasure, Lin Yuan could sense the exceedingly terrifying physique of the Demon God.

Just standing there, the invisible aura radiated, shaking the heavy space-time of the Source World, and the pervading demonic qi was indeed part of this body’s physique.

"How did such a powerful body come to be, what about its mind and will?"

Lin Yuan’s thoughts spun.

Undoubtedly, the Demon God should also be a time life, a tremendously powerful one at that.

Point is, only the body remains.

And the body’s instinct causes it to begin emanating demonic qi, eroding the entire Source World.

"Hope it just wakes occasionally, and soon goes back to slumber."

Several Sect Masters of the Eternal Sects prayed in their hearts, knowing there were times in the past when the Demon God awakened, merely glanced at the heavens and earth, then fell back into slumber.

The sects hoped everything would be just like before.

Sigh.

Demonic qi drifted, the Demon God’s expression detached, gaze hollow, after scanning around, bits and pieces of information flooded its mind.

Compared to other large demons, Source Demons, the Demon God’s instinct is more specific, that is to thoroughly erode the entire Source World.

And eroding the Source World divides into two parts, one is it instinctively suppressing the Source World consciousness, the other is using the demonic qi to nurture tens of thousands of ’demons’, which erode the Source World itself.

One internal, one external, to erode the Source World as swiftly as possible.

But this time upon awakening, the Demon God was startled to find that the ’demons’ it nurtured with demonic qi were already diminutive.

The vast majority of ’demons’ have returned to consciousness state, re-nurturing deep within the demonic qi.

As for the remaining Source Demons? Also trembling with fear, hiding away, daring not to continue eroding the world.

Boom!

The Demon God stepped forward, appearing above the Hidden World, its hollow gaze looked down.
